name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
On the Nvidia situation:

Nvidia's board can still make things right.

It has now been 48 hours since Jensen Huang resigned from his role as CEO, President, and board member of Nvidia.

Meanwhile, a thorough investigation has not been completed, countless critical questions are unanswered, and one of the world's greatest CEOs was forced out before the full facts of the situation were established.

In fact, the US Attorney General, the CIA, the DNI, and members of the House Intelligence Committee have also suggested that the current evidence remains inconclusive regarding whether Jensen Huang was involved in an affair with a Chinese spy.

The reality is that Jensen Huang resigned in the heat

name: Brivael Le Pogam
text:
Haiti just ran the cleanest A/B test of the century.

Option A: the international system. Thirteen years of UN peacekeeping, billions in aid, an army of NGOs. Result: a president assassinated in his own bedroom, a capital run by gangs, more than a million people displaced. The peacekeepers themselves brought cholera to the island and killed nearly 10,000 Haitians. After the 2010 earthquake, the Red Cross raised half a billion dollars and built six permanent homes. Six. Oxfam staff were caught paying for sex workers in the ruins.

Option B: Bukele. A few weeks, 2,000 soldiers, armored vehicles, one clear objective. Result: the gangs are now writing letters to the UN asking for "mediation."
